title: AI for Industry — 10 Receipts for Recent Graduates
principle: Do not study AI in the abstract. Study a real system, change one bounded loop, and leave proof somebody can inspect.

parts.title: Find a Problem with a Pulse
parts.receipt: One-page problem brief with owner, current loop, measurable change, constraints, and finish line

parts.title: Put Fable and Sol on the Same Brief
parts.receipt: Two-agent comparison using the same brief, separate branches, the same tests, and a human merge decision

parts.title: Make the Smallest Thing People Can Touch
parts.receipt: Working prototype with a complete path, failure state, automated check, mobile pass, and observer note

parts.title: Touch One Real API
parts.receipt: API contract with a source link, redacted request and response, error behavior, and integration test

parts.title: Connect the Work Without Connecting Everything
parts.receipt: One reversible, least-privilege connector flow with an audit note

parts.title: Direct Moving Image
parts.receipt: Two-engine, five-shot study with the same references, evaluation, generation log, and rights note

parts.title: The Generated Clip Is Raw Footage
parts.receipt: Human-edited 20 to 30 second cut with mixed sound, captions, provenance, master, and delivery export

parts.title: Make Money Move Safely in Test Mode
parts.receipt: Test payment receipt covering hosted Checkout, confirmation, fulfillment, state changes, and refund

parts.title: Make the Phone Ring with Consent
parts.receipt: Consent-safe messaging or voice test with one verified recipient and delivery-state evidence

parts.title: Ship the Whole Loop
parts.receipt: Public-safe launch receipt with problem, decisions, tests, canonical URL, limits, and rollback
